description: Convert a config file to JSON, or JSON back to readable YAML. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

direction.description: yaml-to-json parses YAML and returns JSON; json-to-yaml parses JSON and returns YAML. Defaults to yaml-to-json.

indent.description: Spaces of indentation in the output. For JSON, 0 gives a single line; YAML output always indents by at least 1. Defaults to 2.

sortKeys.description: Sort object keys alphabetically at every level, so two configs can be compared. Off by default, which keeps the input's order.

text.description: The document to convert: YAML when direction is yaml-to-json, JSON when it is json-to-yaml. A YAML file holding several --- documents becomes a JSON array.

name: yaml_to_json
title: YAML to JSON
